description: Ex-Aeronautique navale carrier trainer mounted on a stele in front of the Le Surplus military-surplus shop beside the A7 motorway south of Valence, in naval markings and regularly maintained. Listed on the shop's own Avions page in 2025.

Ex-Belgian Air Force reconnaissance Mirage 5BR displayed at the Le Surplus military-surplus shop beside the A7. Recorded and photographed there in Nicolas Pillet's Mirage 5 survivor register; the shop's own 2025 Avions page names only the Fouga Zephyr, so a visitor should check both are still standing.
